shots.focal_element: Black profile silhouette of the presenter in front of a soft circular gradient glow, with the words arcing around it
shots.transition_other: video start (first shot, no incoming transition)
shots.typography: Heavy geometric sans, all caps, white, set on a circular path: WORK arcs over the head, TODAY arcs under the chin; TODAY appears motion-blurred as it animates in. Small ClickUp logo watermark bottom-right.
shots.what_happens: Opens on a silhouette against a blurred gradient orb; 'WORK' is already arced above the head and 'TODAY' rotates/blurs in along the lower arc, timed to the voice-over words w0-w1.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a black silhouette PNG over a large radial-gradient blurred circle on black, render each word on an SVG circular textPath, and animate the second word in with a rotation along the path plus a motion-blur filter that resolves to sharp over about 0.3 s.

shots.focal_element: Presenter speaking to camera with the word BROKEN behind him
shots.typography: Very large heavy geometric sans, all caps, wide tracking, gradient-filled letters with a soft outer glow, placed behind the presenter (presenter keyed in front of the type). Shatters into particle shards.
shots.what_happens: Presenter on black says 'is broken' (w2-w3); the word BROKEN appears behind him and fractures into flying shards, then by ~2.0 s the frame already shows the presenter standing in a bright open office (the sheet frame at 0:02.000 suggests the office cut lands slightly before the detected s003 boundary). An impact SFX (x001) lands at 1.65 s near 'broken'.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a keyed presenter over a large glowing gradient word on black, then replace the word with a particle-shatter (split glyphs into polygon fragments that scatter outward with random velocity and fade) synced to the spoken word and an impact hit.

shots.focal_element: Presenter walking toward camera in an office, with kinetic captions and floating app icons around him
on_screen_text: people juggle so many different tools
shots.typography: Lowercase bold geometric sans, white, tight tracking, words stacked in loose clusters in the space around the presenter; each new word blurs/scales in while older words fade and blur out; 'tools' and 'done' rendered with a blue-to-pink gradient fill as emphasis words.
shots.what_happens: Handheld walk-and-talk in an open office while the voice-over (w4-w16) is captioned word by word; app tiles (Google Drive, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Google Meet, Google Calendar) pop in and drift around the frame, some entering large and close to camera from the edges, illustrating tool overload. Several glitch-like SFX (x002-x005) and a reverse swoosh (x006) accompany the pops.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a tracked presenter plate, reveal each transcript word at its word timestamp with a blur-to-sharp scale-in, fade earlier words to 40% opacity with blur, and spawn rounded-square app icons with a soft drop shadow that pop in with spring overshoot and drift at different depths to fake parallax.

shots.focal_element: Extreme close-up of the presenter's face in glasses, looking down to the right
shots.typography: Lowercase bold geometric sans, white, left-aligned in the left third, words appearing one at a time and wrapping to a second line.
shots.what_happens: Cinematic shallow-depth close-up on the presenter's face while 'a simple task' (w17-w19) types on word by word in the negative space at left.
shots.build_rebuild: Use a shallow-focus close-up plate and add left-aligned white captions in the left third that reveal word by word at each word's start time with a quick fade-up.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of a smartwatch on the presenter's wrist, then hands on a mechanical keyboard
shots.typography: 'turns into' in lowercase bold geometric sans, white, left third; 'TIME' in all caps of the same family, centred above the keyboard.
shots.what_happens: Wrist close-up checking a watch while 'turns into' (w20-w21) is captioned, then the picture changes within this detected shot to a low-angle keyboard close-up with 'TIME' appearing (w23); the second angle appears to be an undetected cut. A chime SFX (x009) lands around 8.62 s.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut between two shallow-focus B-roll inserts (watch, keyboard) on the spoken words and swap the caption style from lowercase left-aligned to an all-caps centred word when the scene changes.

shots.focal_element: Hands typing on a mechanical keyboard with stacked caption words over it
shots.typography: All-caps bold geometric sans, white, stacked centred; each new word lands large and the stack then scales down and re-centres as the next word arrives.
shots.what_happens: Keyboard B-roll continues while 'time-consuming mess' (w23-w25) builds as a stacked all-caps word list that rescales on each entry; at the end of the shot (around 10.0 s) the frame switches to a dark screen with greyed app icons (an OpenAI-style knot, GitHub) and a mouse cursor, which appears to be the start of the next sequence rather than part of this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Stack caption words vertically in the centre, pop each new word in at its timestamp at large size, and animate the whole stack's scale down and recentre (layout reframe) as each new line is added.
